correctness.rationale: For the unsigned incidence matrix B of the cycle flower, the line-graph Hamiltonian is B-transpose B minus twice identity, so the original flat band is ker B. Non-hub vertex conditions impose alternating nonzero amplitudes around each active petal; the hub cancels each even petal and forces the sum of odd-petal coefficients to vanish. The onsite eigenvalue constraint requires each active petal to be monochromatic, establishing exact necessity and sufficiency, plus the whole-space invariance and local-loss threshold. Binomial counts and the strong law yield the iid alphabet formula and limit. The included SymPy checker verifies 77 exact onsite patterns, five absorber placements each and four exhaustive binary-disorder enumerations. Finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
